column1: # Sinhala OCR confusion rules for lipi_script::correct.
# `weight` is the share of occurrences of `ocr` in Tesseract output that should have been
# `truth`, so it is the probability that the rule applies to a given occurrence.
# Derived on 2026-10-08 with bench/postcorrect/learn.py from 48 synthetic A4 pages (8 texts in
# Sinhala MN, Sinhala Sangam MN and Noto Sans Sinhala, clean and degraded) recognised by
# Tesseract 5.5.2 with tessdata_best `sin` (e12c65a), aligned with their ground truth. The pages
# were rendered from 102 Sri Lankan cabinet-decision texts kept apart from both the lexicon
# documents and the evaluation documents. Rules seen fewer than 4 times, sources longer than two
# code points and targets longer than three were dropped. The table holds code points only.
